articles.summary: FORT COLLINS, Colo., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Woodward, Inc. (NASDAQ: WWD), a global leader in aerospace and industrial controls solutions, today announced four executive leadership appointments that advance the company’s succession plans, maintain business continuity, and support its strategy and long-term growth. All appointments will be effective January 1, 2027. Tom Cromwell , currently Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, will take on the role of Executive Vice President, Strategic Initiatives, continuing to report to Chairman and CEO Chip Blankenship. He will support special project execution for Woodward’s Aerospace segment. The Chief Operating Officer position will not be backfilled at this time. Randy Hobbs , currently Executive Vice President and President of Woodward’s Industrial segment, will become Executive Vice President and Chief Transformation Officer, continuing to report to Blankenship. articles.summary: FORT COLLINS, Colo., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Woodward, Inc. (NASDAQ: WWD), a global leader in aerospace and industrial energy control solutions, today announced it has been named to the 2026 Fortune® 100 Fastest-Growing Companies List in recognition of its strong growth performance. Now in its 41st year, the annual Fortune list brings together 100 U.S.-listed public companies across a range of industries.
